title: Live-Action Look Back Film's Trailer Reveals More Cast, September 11 Opening
content: The officiall website for the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga unveiled a new trailer for the film on Wednesday. The trailer announces more cast members for the film, as well as its September 11 opening date in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Yoruichi Faces Askin Nakk Le Vaar in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 41 Preview
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 1 (Episode 41 overall). The anime is returning with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. The anime premiered early in US theaters with the first three episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: Netflix Is Losing a Major Fantasy Anime in August
content: 2026 has been an exciting year for anime fans with the premiere of several exciting shows on Netflix, such as Love Through a Prism, Cosmic Princess Kaguya, Dandelion , and more. However, while the platform keeps bringing new series for fans, it’s also quietly removing some beloved series as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds New Titles in Latest July 2026 Update
content: July is turning out to be one of the best months of the year for anime and manga fans. Following the new Summer 2026 anime series, which were added on Crunchyroll this month, the official manga platform also confirms a few new entries.

title: Chiho Saitō's VS Lupin Manga Ends
content: The summer issue of Shogakukan 's Zōkan Flowers magazine published the final chapter of Chiho Saitō 's VS Lupin manga on Tuesday. The manga, based on the original thief Arsène Lupin by French novelist Maurice Leblanc , launched in the inaugural issue of Zōkan Flowers in 2012.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Gets One Step Closer to Return With New Release This October
content: Solo Leveling is all set for its anticipated film after making fans wait for more than a year since the Season 2 finale. The anime wrapped up the fan-favorite Jeju Island Arc in Season 2, leaving behind several questions for fans to answer.
author: ComicBook

title: Harukana Receive's Nyoijizai Launches New Manga
content: Manga author Nyoijizai launched a new manga titled Shinkon Dakedo Captain no Kanojo to wa Mada Yarenai ( I'm newly married, but I still can't have sex with the captain's girlfriend ) on Kadokawa 's Dra Dra Sharp# online manga magazine last Saturday. The manga centers on newlywed couple Yūto and Asuka.
author: ANN

title: Manga Creator matoba Launches New Fantasy Series on August 12
content: The August issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine revealed last Friday that manga creator matoba will launch a new series titled Eden no Tō : Luluchikakunia to Tō no Meikyū (Tower of Eden: Luluchikakunia and the Tower Labyrinth) in the magazine's next issue on August 12.
author: ANN
